nodes.name: power_nonisolated_3v3
nodes.description: Non-isolated 3.3V regulator built around U1 XC6206. It converts the external VIN_5V rail into the internal VCC_3V3 rail used by the STM32F103 and the MCU-side supply domain of the ISO7721 isolators. This module is the only provider of the non-isolated 3.3V rail and must remain entirely on the GND domain with no connection to ISO_GND.
3.3V LDO for non-isolated side

nodes.name: power_isolated_3v3
nodes.description: Isolated-side 3.3V regulator built around U2 XC6206. It converts the external ISO_5V rail into the internal ISO_3V3 rail for the ADS1118 digital/analog supply and the isolated-side supply domain of the ISO7721 devices. This module is the only provider of the isolated 3.3V rail and must remain entirely on the ISO_GND domain with no connection to GND.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 microcontroller on the non-isolated domain. It is powered from VCC_3V3 and acts as the SPI master for the isolated ADS1118 acquisition path. This module originates SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, and SPI_CS_ADC toward the isolation barrier, and receives SPI_MISO returned from the ADC through the barrier. The MCU remains on GND only and must not have any direct electrical connection to isolated-side rails or ISO_GND.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: spi_isolation_forward
nodes.description: First ISO7721 dual-channel isolator providing two non-isolated-to-isolated SPI forward paths. It is powered from VCC_3V3 on the MCU side and ISO_3V3 on the isolated side, preserving galvanic isolation between GND and ISO_GND. This module carries two of the three required master-to-ADC control signals across the barrier. Because each ISO7721 provides only two channels and the brief requires SCK, MOSI, CS, and return data, channel allocation must be split across two devices.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: spi_isolation_cs_return
nodes.description: Second ISO7721 dual-channel isolator providing the remaining SPI isolation links: one non-isolated-to-isolated chip-select path and one isolated-to-non-isolated ADC return-data path. It is powered from VCC_3V3 on the MCU side and ISO_3V3 on the isolated side, and it completes the four required isolated SPI channels using the two available dual isolators. This module enforces the galvanic barrier and must not create any shared power or ground between GND and ISO_GND.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: adc_isolated
nodes.description: ADS1118 precision SPI ADC on the isolated domain. It is powered from ISO_3V3 and communicates only through the isolated SPI links. REF5050 output is routed to one ADC analog input as required by the brief, while remaining analog inputs are left available as isolated analog measurement inputs. The ADC stays entirely referenced to ISO_GND and must not share any ground or supply with the MCU domain.
16-bit SPI ADC on isolated side

nodes.name: reference_isolated
nodes.description: REF5050 precision 5.0V reference on the isolated domain. It is powered directly from the external ISO_5V rail and provides a precision analog reference output that must connect to one ADS1118 analog input. This module remains fully referenced to ISO_GND and must not cross the isolation barrier. Any local stability or decoupling support is handled downstream without changing the macro connectivity.
